body: The light casts a golden glow on the velvet-like texture of the loft, illuminating the faint hum of the choir practice. I strain my ears, trying to pinpoint the source of the melody, but it seems to be coming from nowhere. The smell of old wood and dust fills my nostrils, transporting me to another era. I feel drawn towards the light, my curiosity piqued.
